checks: A reversible metre-scale layout keeps a 12 metre road and 2.7 metre left lane offset across five compact districts
Every directed road follows a sampled curve in the left lane; all 764 legal turn paths stay on the drivable road
Vehicle bodies clear every sampled road, turn, alley and service entrance; lamp, signal and camera footprints stay outside the asphalt
Rendered road and ground triangles agree with tyre material/height sampling; grass tufts stay on grass and no probe has coplanar surface overlap
Reset poses consistently use the left side in both directions and avoid intersections and colliders
limits: Real Three.js meshes, world collision boxes, road sampling and ray intersections in Node. No browser GPU image comparison.
The city is a compact, curved grid with driveable courtyard alleys, not a streamed open-world engine.
